scenario: No exact backing → reject, per LSER.10.19 / LSER.15.2 (v1). In v1 `pXX` / `median` are exact over a bounded window's raw samples (SeriesBackendRingBuffer on `sliding`, SeriesBackendReservoir on `sample`); the `all_time` and `tumbling` forms have no exact backing. Pin: `p95 all_time` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_NO_EXACT_BACKING; the diagnostic names the unreachable cell and points at the bounded form (`p95 sliding <dur>` / `p95 sample <n>`).
